Only group-level claim found on tafe.com (parent Tractors and Farm Equipment Limited): 'an Indian tractor major incorporated in 1960 at Chennai, India, with an annual turnover in excess of INR 16,000 crores' — this is the TAFE group figure, not TMTL-specific, and is a company self-statement, not a supply record. TMTL is listed on tafe.com as a business vertical ('TMTL Farm Equipment Division', 'TMTL-Eicher Agro Engines', 'TMTL-Eicher Silent Gensets'), i.e. catalogue/registry-level only.
note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated Indian customs/B-L records: tractors and parts under HS 870191/870192/870193/870899 shipped Feb 2026 to Tanzania (Dar Es Salaam), Nepal (Dhangarhi) and Peru (Callao), with B-L numbers quoted above. Declared HS 870190/870191/870899 is consistent with observed 870191/870192/870193/870899 — no HS correction needed. Domestic side: no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or contract evidence was obtained in this session (search tooling unavailable), so domestic_status is declared_only, not confirmed — this is a tooling gap, not a finding of no supplies. Revenue: TMTL-specific revenue is not public in the sources read — null; the INR 16,000 crore figure belongs to parent TAFE (Tractors and Farm Equipment Limited) and must not be attributed to TMTL. Export volume in units/value: null (not public in free view). Note the entity appears in customs data under several name variants (TAFE MOTORS AND TRACTORS LIMITED / LTD, and as 'EICHER AGRICULTURE TRACTOR' brand on Nepal shipments); the 'M/S EICHER TRACTORS (UNIT OF TAFE MOTORS & TRACTOR LTD.)' variant is a unit designation of the same legal entity. No rejection grounds: legal entity exists and is active.
